scripts.build:service:dev: cargo build -p service --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cp src-tauri/target/debug/service src-tauri/binaries/service-$(rustc -Vv | grep host | cut -d' ' -f2)
scripts.build:service:release: cargo build -p service --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cp src-tauri/target/release/service src-tauri/binaries/service-$(rustc -Vv | grep host | cut -d' ' -f2)
